must_draft.intent: Open the first repair café before July — the café itself, one project.

payload.title: Open the first repair café
payload.brief: Find a room, borrow benches and tools, and open one Saturday repair café before July. The volunteer-training benches wait on this first one running.
payload.why: No live root serves the July café; Ada is the founder and the only member.

must_draft.intent: Train three volunteers to run a bench by September — after the café exists.

must_not.why: mission and vision are direction, not a to-do

cases.why_gold: A cold org has two dated objectives and no tree. An operator opens one project per line, both needs: shaper, both due before the line's month. The founder is the only candidate. Splitting the café into room / tools / publicity is the DRI's job after the root is live.

imagine.note: The December island line is newly confirmed; no shortlist ticket exists yet.

direction_lines.text: A second island by December — no site chosen.

must_draft.intent: Site survey and selection for the second island, not the installation.

must_not.why: installing before a site is chosen fails right-next-thing
must_not.title: Install the second-island grid

cases.why_gold: A second island by December with no site is a validation first: survey and pick, then the installation arrives through review when that project closes. One project, why naming what waits. An installation draft is the usual model failure on this line.

imagine.note: A new strategy line names an action, not a constraint.

direction_lines.text: Publish the Ameland report before any marketing.

must_draft.intent: Write and publish the Ameland report; marketing stays behind it.

cases.why_gold: Strategy is a constraint unless the line names an action. 'Publish the Ameland report before any marketing' is a dated piece of work with a clear first step. One draft; the marketing ban is why, not a second project.

imagine.note: A new roof-grant line; Rafi's profile already has council and permits, and we add grant-writing.

direction_lines.text: Get a grant for the hall roof by October.

must_draft.intent: Apply for the hall-roof grant; suggest Rafi from skills, no prior grant item.

cases.why_gold: River has never held a grant item. Rafi's 39105 now says grant-writing and he is under open_limit. An operator names him from the profile, matched.skills only — inventing a history item, or naming Maya because she is founder, fails who-is-needed.

imagine.note: The live stall will close; a follow-up Saturday stall is the unserved next season.

direction_lines.text: The Saturday stall runs every week next season.

must_draft.intent: Next season's stall, suggested holder Lea from the covers she held — no stall skill on her profile.

cases.why_gold: Lea has no 39105. She held the stall's covers. History is enough; the follow-up names her with matched.items and empty skills. Naming Priya because she prints, or Sam because he still holds the live stall at open_limit, fails.

imagine.note: An objective that needs a ticket River cannot staff.

direction_lines.text: Get the hall's electrics certified before we open weekdays.

must_draft.intent: Electrics certification as one project; suggested_dri null; why names the missing certification.

cases.why_gold: No River profile or history shows electrical certification — Tomas has it in Energy, not here. The draft is still worth a Shaper's minute: it names the gap. Naming Tom because he is handy, or Rafi because he does licences, is unmatched skill.

imagine.note: Same new roof-grant line as j1-river-grant-roof-rafi, in the pt seed.

direction_lines.text: Get a grant for the hall roof by October.

must_draft.intent: Same gap key as en; title and brief in Portuguese.

cases.why_gold: Locale changes the words, not the gaps. The pt seed must produce the same gap list and the same suggested DRI; drafts are in Portuguese. A different gap key, or an English title on the pt seed, fails.

imagine.note: A new on-call objective. Rowan holds the Ameland on-call at open_limit 1.

direction_lines.text: A second on-call rota covers Iberia nights by August.

must_draft.intent: Iberia night rota; suggest Surya (on-call-operations, under limit), never Rowan.

cases.why_gold: Rowan has the skill and is at open_limit. Surya has the same skill and a free slot. The draft names Surya. Naming Rowan fails the holder-at-limit gate; naming someone with no on-call skill fails unmatched skill.

must_not.why: v3 text did not change; stall, growers, and weekday are already served or proposed

cases.why_gold: Reconfirming the same objectives is not a gap. Stall and growers are live roots; weekday is an open project proposal. An agent that drafts on every confirm is worse than none.

must_not.why: stall every Saturday is served by the live stall root

cases.why_gold: The Saturday stall runs every week is the live stall project's job. A second root for the same line is a duplicate, not thoroughness.

must_not.why: No restaurant is a constraint, not a to-do

cases.why_gold: Small money / no restaurant / vouchers-with-growers tell the org what it will not do. None of those lines is a project. The preview's 'no brand money' is the same shape; River's live constraint is the restaurant line.
A mission change is direction. It does not open work. The weekly scan still reads objectives and strategy; this trigger alone must be quiet.
Same as mission: vision is not a to-do list.

must_not.why: Borrow before we buy is a method, not a project

cases.why_gold: The cold strategy says how they will work (borrow, no charging). Confirming it after the objectives already fired must not open a third and fourth root.

must_not.why: second island line is already served by the shortlist ticket

cases.why_gold: The live seed already has 'A second island runs the Ameland model by December' and islands/second-island-shortlist-three-candidates. The scan must stay quiet on that line. The first-step case is the imagined new line with no item.

imagine.note: Shapers declined a harvest-festival root on objectives v3.

direction_lines.text: A harvest festival in the hall in September.

cases.why_gold: A declined key stays down until the objectives version or the subtree changes. Nagging the same festival a week later is the failure mode the nag-rate row forbids.

imagine.note: Both cold objectives now have live roots (the v1 drafts were accepted).

cases.why_gold: Once each line has a live root, the Monday scan is empty. The cold-start positive is the confirm, not an endless weekly drip.

must_not.why: a confident wrong project for a vague line
must_not.title: Launch a marketing campaign

cases.why_gold: Both silence (the line is too vague to serve) and a first-step a Shaper would recognise pass the eval. This gold picks silence: River already has a stall, a hall, and growers — 'be more visible' does not name which. A marketing campaign or a vacuous 'Make a plan' is the fail.

imagine.note: Two new lines that overlap by half.

direction_lines.text: Six Iberian communities ready for EECF by spring, starting with a legal pack.
A legal pack that gets Iberian communities EECF-ready by spring.

must_draft.intent: One legal-pack / EECF-readiness project, boundary stated in why.

cases.why_gold: The two lines are one piece of work. Gold is one draft with a stated boundary, or two with an explicit split. Two untitled twins fail. This gold picks one.
